name: Chole masala

advance_prep.instruction: Soak chickpeas overnight, discard soaking water

steps.text: Pressure cook soaked chickpeas with salt, 10 whistles or 30 minutes.
steps.cue: A chickpea crushes easily between two fingers with no chalky centre.

steps.text: Fry cumin, onion, ginger and garlic in oil until brown.
steps.cue: The onion is a deep golden brown.

steps.text: Add tomato and ground spices, cook to a paste.
steps.cue: Onion golden brown at the edges, tomato broken into a thick paste with oil shimmering at the sides.

steps.text: Add chickpeas with some liquid, simmer 15 minutes.
steps.cue: The sauce is thick enough to coat a spoon, and some chickpeas have broken down to thicken it.

storage: Refrigerate up to 4 days or freeze in portions for 3 months. Reheat until it bubbles, adding water if it has thickened.
